authority: Only M05 planning documents and own board evidence. No Skeleton, test target or product behavior created.
intent: Evaluate immutable asset retention using explicit complete root projections. Pure eligibility is never authority to physically delete.
confirmed_baseline: Single-document merge plus necessary asset/reference changes only
Undo cannot delete material still used elsewhere
Formal save retains recovery versions until an approved retention policy cleans them
M02 C+B pending precision does not block this independent M05 preparation review

architecture.hexagonal: Test/future HOST use case -> WORK evaluate_asset_retention; no output port in this pure slice. Future HOST collects authoritative root projections through separately approved capabilities.
architecture.dependencies: M04 history/document owners + M07 retained snapshots + transaction owner provide projections; M05 evaluates them without mutation. No implementation of those providers in S1.
architecture.ownership: Owning modules retain SSOT and root lifecycle; RootSnapshot is immutable derived data. Evaluation result has no FS handle, cleanup lease or deletion token.
architecture.mutation: None. Inputs borrowed immutably; no IDs allocated, paths resolved or catalog changed.
architecture.transaction: None in S1. Physical cleanup still requires separately approved completeness/freshness fencing and durable catalog transaction. Never invoke remove_file based solely on Eligible.

public_boundary_proposed.note: Nested Completeness and reason discriminants are data only. New Port, crypto hashing, material cache, catalog persistence, timer and cleanup manager are excluded.

order: Validate nonempty bounded identity strings and digest syntax; reject malformed/duplicate provider kinds or duplicate expected revisions with InvalidInput.
Exactly five required root kinds must be explicitly represented. Missing kind, Unknown status or mismatched expected revision produces conservative Retain reason, never complete-empty eligibility.
Matching exact asset_id+digest reference retains by root and owner. Same asset_id with an unresolved conflicting digest retains as IdentityConflict; no guessing provenance.
Candidate belongs to this operation only when owned_by_operation equals context.operation_id. Otherwise retain as NotOwnedByOperation.
EligibleForCleanup only when all five providers are Complete and expected revisions match, no relevant reference/conflict exists and candidate is operation-owned.
contracts.identity: root project/session equals context project/session; mismatch is InvalidInput. LiveDocuments contains every project document, not just active document. Session key does not exclude other sessions from root completeness.
contracts.output: Reasons deduplicated and sorted by fixed root order LiveDocuments/UndoHistory/RedoHistory/RecoverySnapshots/InFlightTransactions, then reason discriminator and owner_id byte order. Eligible carries identity only; never path or permission.
contracts.failure: No input mutation; malformed input errors do not hide root-incomplete state by pretending deletion is allowed.
contracts.trust: HOST must obtain honest root completeness. Strings/revision equality alone do not authenticate providers or grant native deletion authority.

limits_proposed_not_confirmed.oversize: InvalidInput; no truncation or partial completeness claim
